summary: Molecular side is covered (GenBank has 144,139 Cirripedia sequence records; Open Tree gives a synthetic topology) and developmental expression data exist (Bgee 52 species, GEO 7,791 embryonic-development series), but no stage-partitioned embryonic or larval character matrix was found in an openly reachable repository (MorphoBank returned 403 to scripts, and three Dryad searches returned no hits).
next_step: Compile larval versus adult character partitions for a few modified-adult clades (barnacles, Rhizocephala, tunicates, parasitic copepods) from the original literature, or retry MorphoBank from a browser to see whether any project partitions characters by life stage.
obstacles_confirmed: Comparative embryology matrices exist for scattered groups, not for animal groups in general.
No stage-partitioned character matrix was found in a reachable repository; Bgee covers only 52 species.
